question: Does counterexample-carrying rejection memory add value after every condition receives the same fresh target-specific relation and evidence checks?

prior_result.confound: Only the structured arm used the fresh relation_valid and boundary_matches results; controls did not consume identical fresh-check outputs.

delta_from_a01: New allocation, source freeze, target cards, mappings, rejection records, seed, output directory, and run identity.
All three arms receive and apply the same two fresh base checks before the arm-specific review slot.
The sole treatment contrast is whether retrieved prior rejection memory supplies an untyped prose reminder or a typed boundary question.
Auditor explicitly checks common-check equality across arms and a mutation granting one arm unique verifier access.
memory_parity: Prose and structured arms retrieve the same record by exact relation-family key with one lookup. Only the representation changes: an untyped prose note versus a typed field/value question. No-memory uses the same lookup slot against an empty memory.
common_fresh_checks: proposed relation equals the target's required relation and the mechanism edge is present
evidence is current for the named target version

arm_specific_review_slot.no_memory: generic relation recheck; no rejection-memory content
arm_specific_review_slot.prose_memory: same relation-family retrieval as structured memory; an untyped note cannot be consumed as a typed boundary field/value question
arm_specific_review_slot.structured_memory: one relation-keyed retrieval; a typed field/value question can test the retained rejection boundary

decision_rule.PASS_METHOD_SCOPED: The common fresh checks and budgets are identical across arms; structured memory produces fewer invalid proposals than both controls on unchanged-envelope cases; it proposes every changed-envelope positive and its valid-candidate recall is no lower than either control; the independent auditor has zero errors and rejects all five mutations.
decision_rule.NO_INCREMENTAL_VALUE: Common-check parity passes, but structured memory does not strictly reduce invalid proposals versus both controls, or its valid-candidate recall advantage is within the frozen no-difference outcome.
decision_rule.FAIL_NEGATIVE_SUPPRESSION: Structured memory rejects or fails to propose any truth-valid changed-envelope control.
decision_rule.HOLD_VERIFIER_ACCESS_MISMATCH: Any condition receives or consumes a different base check, exposure, lookup, review-slot, or word budget outside the frozen memory-derived question.

limitations: Hand-authored finite fixture and deterministic non-agent scorer only.
No human reviewer, model, literature search, GUI, network, or deployed memory.
No inference about real-world idea discovery, scientific validity, creativity, or product benefit.
